Future explicit material contract overrides require separate review; evidence is versioned to current rules.

standard: Complementary positions must remain economically complementary across every material settlement state.
systematicity_basis: Material differences are in current family-level primary rules and recur without a countervailing override across three sampled events/nine full-game total records. Ordinary threshold alignment cannot cure those differences; unknown fields are not promoted to matches.
threshold_notes: 7.5 selected for each game. All three also have 8.5/9.5 overlap. No integer market sampled or push refund inferred. Kalshi whole-number predicates follow their explicit operator; Polymarket integer behavior stays UNKNOWN.
viability: Not viable as strict all-material-state riskless arbitrage under the audited current rules. This does not assess non-riskless trading profitability.
